title: Mandell Theatre
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: The 424 seat proscenium theater is the primary performance venue for performances by the Theater, Music, and Dance programs here at Drexel University. Mandell is also used for Drexel University events and special presentations by outside organizations. Schedule permitting, the Mandell Theater is available for rental outside of the Academic Quarters.
